title: Location config page is always shown regardless of pluginName
line: A widget's settings window no longer opens on a hidden page that isn't listed in its sidebar.
explanation: AppletConfiguration.qml opened configModel.get(0) when the dialog was created, without looking at the category's visible flag, while the sidebar lists only visible categories through its filter model. For the desktop containment run as an applet, the first category is Location, which is hidden there, so the dialog showed a page with no sidebar entry and nothing selected. The dialog now opens the first entry of the sidebar's filter model (or Keyboard Shortcuts when the applet has no visible pages), in both plasma-desktop's shell and plasmoidviewer's copy.

commits.message:
desktoppackage/configuration: Don't open settings on a hidden page

A widget whose first config category is hidden opened its settings on
that page anyway, which the sidebar doesn't list, with nothing selected.
Open the first page the sidebar lists instead, skipping hidden ones.

BUG: 454579

plasmoidviewer: Don't open settings on a hidden page

The config dialog always opened the applet's first category even when
hidden, so the desktop containment showed its Location page, which the
sidebar doesn't list. Open the first page the sidebar lists instead.

BUG: 454579

media.caption: plasmoidviewer -a org.kde.desktopcontainment, Configure Containment: the dialog shows the Location page, which the sidebar doesn't list
Same steps with the fix: the dialog opens on Keyboard Shortcuts, selected in the sidebar

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in both plasma-desktop's and plasma-sdk's AppletConfiguration.qml. Switching Component.onCompleted to check configDialogFilterModel (the same KSortFilterProxyModel filtering on ConfigModel.VisibleRole that populates the sidebar) and map its first row back to configDialog.configModel ensures hidden categories are skipped and safely falls back to globalConfigModel.get(0) when no visible applet pages exist or configModel is null. Before/after screenshots and plasmashell regression checks confirm the fix cleanly.
